subject: geography
sourceName: WJEC Eduqas GCE A Level Geography specification (from 2016)

units.n: 1. Component 1 — Changing Landscapes and Changing Places
subs: Section A: Changing Landscapes (choose one) — Coastal Landscapes OR Glaciated Landscapes

units.n: 2. Component 2 — Global Systems and Global Governance
subs: Section A: Global Systems — Water and Carbon Cycles (compulsory)
Section B: Global Governance — Change and Challenges (global migration and global ocean governance)
Section C: 21st Century Challenges — synoptic extended response drawing on Components 1 and 2
Section A: Tectonic Hazards (compulsory extended response)
Section B: two essays chosen from four optional themes — Ecosystems; Economic Growth and Challenge (India / China / an African context); Energy Challenges and Dilemmas; Weather and Climate
Fieldwork-based written investigation (3000–4000 words) drawing on physical and/or human geography
